help.interval_suffix: Display suffixes for salary intervals such as yearly, monthly, daily, and hourly.
help.interval_divisor: Divisors used when normalising source salary ranges into a shared scale.
help.currencies_with_dollar: Currencies that should render with a dollar sign instead of a currency code prefix.
help.period_inference: Conservative Australian salary/rate amount bands used only when the source omits an explicit period. Values outside these clear bands remain period-unclear rather than being guessed.
